title: Week 17 arm W17-6: lever 4 (conformer-averaged dipole) and lever 8 (Li+ coordination block) carried into the model TOGETHER, on the frozen main scoreboard
lock_rule: The criteria and the kill lines in this file are frozen before the v3 run. They are never relaxed afterwards.
what_this_file_is: the first main-scoreboard shot that carries BOTH lever 4 and lever 8 into the model at the same time. It is a NEW, separately counted shot. It does not retroactively validate v1 or v2 and it does not replace them.

v1_and_v2_are_not_edited.rule: every v1 and v2 pre-registration, summary, artefact and report stays byte identical. The v1 decision is `dead` and remains `dead`; the v2 decision is `pass_under_amended_placebo_clause` and remains exactly that. Neither is rewritten here.
v1_and_v2_are_not_edited.why_this_matters: the merge is a new claim. A reader must be able to see the v1 `dead`, the v2 `pass_under_amended_placebo_clause` and this v3 reading side by side, none of them rewritten by the others.

why_this_shot_exists.the_two_shot_merge_discipline_ab_3: lever 4 and lever 8 were measured one at a time and never re-measured together. Until a merge shot runs, the combined effect is unknown: the two blocks touch the same physical axis (polarity / Li+ coordination) and their individual deltas may overlap. This shot is that merge, run once, declared and counted before it is read.
why_this_shot_exists.the_forbidden_extrapolation: the individual readings may NOT be added. +0.0558384525472409 (lever 4) plus +0.044058816215696295 (lever 8) is +0.09989726876293720, and that number is recorded here only to be refused. The merge arm's delta is MEASURED on the frozen scoreboard, never predicted from the singles.
why_this_shot_exists.not_a_rescue: this shot does not revisit the v1 `dead` and does not re-litigate v2's amended clause. Both are quoted verbatim above and left in force.

amended_placebo_clause_reused.rule: the v2 amended clause is reused verbatim, with the placebo arm carrying the MERGED pipeline (lever 4 + lever 8) on the shuffled labels.
amended_placebo_clause_reused.rule_1_floor_upper_bound: the shuffled-label arm must NOT beat its own no-information floor by more than +0.0200. The floor is the training-fold-mean predictor scored on the identical folds AND the identical permuted label vector as the shuffled-label arm.
amended_placebo_clause_reused.rule_2_same_pipeline_on_shuffled_labels: the merged pipeline on shuffled labels must NOT manufacture a gain of more than +0.0200 relative to the same merged pipeline's real-label arm.
amended_placebo_clause_reused.rule_3_within_pipeline_contrast: the merged pipeline on shuffled labels must NOT manufacture a gain of more than +0.0200 against the frozen feature set on the SAME shuffled label vector.
amended_placebo_clause_reused.combination: collapsed = rule_1 AND rule_2 AND rule_3. All three must hold. No threshold is widened: every rule uses the same +0.0200.

main_scoreboard.model: XGBRegressor with the frozen v1.0 hyper-parameters
main_scoreboard.shuffled_vector: the same permutation as v1 and v2 (seed 42 over the scored rows), reused rather than redrawn

lever_4.name: conformer-averaged dipole migration
lever_4.rule: the frozen v0.3 physical block with only the dipole-derived columns replaced by the v0.4 conformer means, read byte identical from probes/artifacts/dielectric_xtb_full_table_migration_conformers.csv. No xTB runs in this shot.

lever_8.name: Li+ coordination block
lever_8.rule: the five columns appended to the frozen physical block, read byte identical from probes/artifacts/dielectric_coordination_block_features.csv. No xTB runs in this shot.

arms: baseline (frozen v03 physical + Morgan, real labels, re-run in this script)
plus_lever4 (the v0.4 conformer-averaged dipole in the physical block, real labels)
plus_lever8 (the five coordination columns appended, real labels)
plus_both (lever 4 and lever 8 together, real labels; THE SHOT)
placebo_shuffled_target (the merged pipeline, target shuffled; the placebo)
baseline_features_shuffled_target (the frozen feature set on the SAME shuffled labels; rule_3 contrast, not a shot)
lever4_features_shuffled_target (the lever-4 pipeline on the SAME shuffled labels; lever-4 shuffle contrast, not a shot)
no_information_floor (training-fold mean, the SAME shuffled labels; reference, not a shot)
no_information_floor_real_labels (training-fold mean, real labels; context, not a shot)
pass_criterion: the baseline arm re-run in this script reproduces 0.4091179943351143 to within 1e-9, AND the grouped Morgan+Physical R2 of the plus_both arm rises by at least +0.0200 against that re-run baseline, AND the reused amended placebo clause collapses
kill_line: delta R2 below +0.0050, or a baseline that does not reproduce (whole shot stamped `unverified` and no delta may be quoted), or any of rule_1 / rule_2 / rule_3 failing -> dead, reported as dead

merge_rule.rule: the merge arm is scored on the frozen scoreboard and its delta is reported against the re-run baseline AND against the best single arm, so a merge that adds nothing is visible.
merge_rule.not_gated_on: beating the best single arm is reported, not gated: the frozen pass criterion names the baseline delta and the amended placebo clause only.

not_a_gate_but_reported: the mae_gt60 stratum, the paired MAE / RMSE / Spearman deltas, the plus_lever4 / plus_lever8 reproduction checks and the merge-over-best-single increment are reported beside the decision. They are not part of the pass criterion.

shots_policy.rule: every scored attempt at the main scoreboard is counted, including failed ones. This merge shot is counted as 1.

forbidden: editing any v1 or v2 pre-registration, summary, artefact or report
editing reports/decisions_log.md, the handbook, or paper/*
adding the lever-4 and lever-8 deltas to predict the merge (+0.09989726876293720 is not a reading)
row-level random splits for any conclusion
letting test residuals steer which columns enter the block
changing the score mask, the compound set or the fold numbers
quoting the v1 `dead` as if it had been overturned, or the v2 pass as if it were this merge
